items.name: melt-switch
items.title: Melt Switch
items.description: A switch whose knob is a drop of glass. It crosses the track by pouring, stretching or dripping, on tuned springs, in your theme's colors. The glass is drawn by Bilal Gürşen's Liquid Glass kit (MIT).

items.name: melt-segmented-control
items.title: Melt Segmented Control
items.description: A segmented control whose selection is a pill of glass. It stretches from segment to segment on tuned springs, and bends and magnifies the label under it, in your theme's colors. The glass is drawn by Bilal Gürşen's Liquid Glass kit (MIT).

items.name: melt-glass
items.title: Melt Glass
items.description: What the melt components share: Bilal Gürşen's Liquid Glass engine (MIT), copied unedited, with its license, and the code that reads theme colors and registers a surface with the engine.
